_comment: Departure airports for the flight package chooser: every large or medium airport with scheduled service and an IATA code, from the OurAirports public-domain dataset. The label folds the municipality in when the name does not carry it, so searching a city finds its airports. Ordered large airports first, then medium, alphabetical within each, which is what ranks the chooser's matches. This list is DEPARTURES ONLY: the package's dst and the venue fact sheets stay on the curated majors in airports.json, because an arrival needs a hub with hotels and inbound flights. Rebuild: scripts/fetch-departure-airports-via-vercel.js.
